results.text:
# Andera Partners

Andera Partners is a Financial Services company. Andera Partners is a leading private equity player that helps companies and their management achieve strong and sustainable growth. They have been in operation for over 20 years and are committed to innovation, growth, and adapting to a rapidly changing environment. Andera Partners employs 157 people (+7.5% YoY, +11 people) and has an annual revenue of EUR77.7M. Headquartered in Paris, Île-de-France, France. Its workforce is distributed across 9 countries (including France, Italy, Spain, Belgium, and Canada).

## About

Created over 20 years ago, Andera Partners is a major player in private company investments in France and internationally. Its teams manage nearly €6 billion in investments in life sciences (Andera Life Sciences), growth and buyout capital (Andera MidCap, Andera Expansion/Croissance, Andera Co-Invest), sponsorless transactions (Andera Acto) and ecological transition (Andera Infra).

Andera Partners’ mission is to work alongside companies and their managers to support them in achieving strong and sustainable growth. The quality of performance offered to our investors relies on a strong partnership between the entrepreneurs in our portfolio companies and our teams, based on shared values. Performance through collective engagement, the “Power of And”, constitutes Andera Partners’ DNA.

Based in Paris, with offices in Antwerp, Madrid, Milan and Munich, Andera Partners counts nearly 120 professionals, of which 72 investment professionals. It is structured as a partnership and managed by a board of 13 partners.

  > 🔎 Last week, Andera Partners' Olivier Litzka moderated an inspiring session on innovation in minimally invasive cardiac valves at #LSIEurope26 in Barcelona.
  >
  > Our thanks to the panellists for such an open and substantive discussion: Eric Schantz, Medtronic, Stefan Pilz, HighLife Medical, Prof. Pawel Buszman, American Heart of Poland /
  > InFlow TAVI (Innovations for Heart and Vessels Sp. z o.o.), Ahmed Elmouelhi, TRiCares GmbH.
  >
  > Many thanks as well as to Henry Peck and Scott Pantel and the whole LSI team for putting together an outstanding event in Barcelona.
  >
  > So what were the conclusions from our discussion?
  > 1- 𝗔𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗶𝗰 𝗶𝘀 𝗺𝗮𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴, 𝗯𝘂𝘁 𝗳𝗮𝗿 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 "𝗱𝗼𝗻𝗲". As TAVI moves to patients in their 60s and 70s, durability and lifetime management of the valve become the defining questions
  > 2- 𝗠𝗶𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗹 𝗵𝗮𝘀 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗲𝗱 𝗶𝘁𝘀 𝗹𝗲𝘀𝘀𝗼𝗻𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗵𝗮𝗿𝗱 𝘄𝗮𝘆. The field had to accept that the mitral valve is a fundamentally different problem: geometry, no "tube" to anchor against, LVOT, chordae. TEER took the market first; the real debate now is which patients, and on what clinical evidence, are better served by replacement. The devices that fit are now arriving on the market.
  > 3- 𝗧𝗿𝗶𝗰𝘂𝘀𝗽𝗶𝗱 𝘀𝗵𝗼𝘄𝘀 𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗲𝗳𝗳𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗰𝘆. Dedicated TTVR devices deliver impressive TR reduction and reverse remodelling, benefits so far largely in quality of life and symptoms, but initial mortality reduction arriving soon. Treating earlier, while the right ventricle is still recoverable, and bringing pacemaker rates down are two important levers.
  > 4- 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗶𝗲𝗿 𝗯𝗲𝘁𝘄𝗲𝗲𝗻 𝘀𝘂𝗿𝗴𝗲𝗿𝘆 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗵𝗲𝘁𝗲𝗿 𝗸𝗲𝗲𝗽𝘀 𝗺𝗼𝘃𝗶𝗻𝗴. Across all three valves, the five-year view of the panel was unanimous: minimally invasive will become the default for a growing group of patients.

properties.description:
Created over 20 years ago, Andera Partners is a major player in private company investments in France and internationally. Its teams manage nearly €6 billion in investments in life sciences (Andera Life Sciences), growth and buyout capital (Andera MidCap, Andera Expansion/Croissance, Andera Co-Invest), sponsorless transactions (Andera Acto) and ecological transition (Andera Infra).

Andera Partners’ mission is to work alongside companies and their managers to support them in achieving strong and sustainable growth. The quality of performance offered to our investors relies on a strong partnership between the entrepreneurs in our portfolio companies and our teams, based on shared values. Performance through collective engagement, the “Power of And”, constitutes Andera Partners’ DNA.

Based in Paris, with offices in Antwerp, Madrid, Milan and Munich, Andera Partners counts nearly 120 professionals, of which 72 investment professionals. It is structured as a partnership and managed by a board of 13 partners.
